newsitem.title: UK: Dixons up as NatWest raises estimates.
newsitem.headline: Dixons up as NatWest raises estimates.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc rose as analysts at Natwest Securities raised earnings estimates for the electrical goods retailer and repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
The stock was up 6p at 550 by 0854 GMT, rebounding since its decline from the record 589p set October 24.
For the year ended April 1997 NatWest raised its pre-tax profit estimate to 195 million stg from 180 million and for 1998 it raised it to 225 million stg from 210 million, market sources said.
Further details were not immediately available and analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
